title: About WebABC | Expert Web Design & SEO Agency
subtitle: Over 10 years of experience delivering high-performance web development and search engine optimization services for growing businesses.
missionText: At WebABC, we guide businesses through their digital transformation journey with our expert team and up-to-date knowledge. Our main goal is to create lasting value for our clients through innovative and results-oriented solutions. We work across web design, development, and SEO as one connected discipline, not three separate vendors, because a fast site with no search visibility and a well-ranked site that's slow to use both fail the same client for different reasons.

items.title: Technical Rigor
items.description: Every project starts with the same technical bar: clean code, real Core Web Vitals targets, and security best practices, whether it's a landing page or a full e-commerce platform.

items.title: Transparent Communication
items.description: You get direct access to the people doing the work, clear timelines, and reporting you can actually understand, not agency jargon dressed up as insight.

items.title: Data Over Opinion
items.description: Design and SEO decisions are grounded in analytics, competitor research, and testing, not personal taste or industry trends that don't fit your business.

items.title: Built to Last
items.description: We build for maintainability, not just launch day. Clean architecture and documentation mean your site doesn't become unmanageable the moment we hand it off.

whoWeServe.title: Who We Work With
whoWeServe.text: We work with small and mid-sized businesses across Iran, the UAE, and Oman that need a website and search presence that actually earns them customers, not just a site that exists. That spans local service businesses that need to rank in their city, agencies and consultants who need a credible digital presence, and online stores that need a fast, reliable storefront on Shopify, WooCommerce, or a custom build.
